system.description: Create a brief, unmoving illusion affecting a single sense (smell, touch, sound, sight). It has no substance and cannot harm anyone; only you can move it if visible. Expend a Willpower Trait and win a Social Challenge against your targets; the illusion persists until you dismiss it, you leave the area, or it is disproved (e.g., a hand passing through it).
system.duration: Until dismissed, disproved, or you leave
